title: Perfect for everything - minus stud earrings. :-)
text: Perfect for everything - minus stud earrings. :-). I was really excited about this jewelry rack, and I couldn't have been more thrilled to see it hung on the wall. (Yep, hubs took care of that part. :-)) I researched quite a few storage solutions for jewelry and found several valet/racks that might fir the bill, but this one seemed to have the most versatility in terms of storage of different kinds of jewelry (bracelets, dangle earrings, long and short necklaces, hair ties, etc.) I love that the lower round racks actually spin in a circle  - great for storing long necklaces & for easy access! I use one of the upper horizontal bars to store my hair bands to keep the cats from getting them. The mesh screen is perfect for dangle earrings. I ALMOST gave this 4 stars instead of 5 because there is no solution for stud earrings. The designers thought of everything else but a tray that could hold miscellaneous baubles & earrings with posts. My solution to this was that I hung a small jewelry pouch from the valet and stored those earrings inside the pouch. It means I have to go rooting through the bag a lot, but really this jewelry valet is just perfect for storing everything else and it looks so cute on the wall. Since I really love it I decided to give it 5 stars, since it does exactly what it's advertised to do. My friends always compliment it and it's helped to keep me MUCH more organized. I posted a picture for you with all my stuff on it so you can see how I've organized everything. Good luck and I hope you like it as much as I do!

product_metadata.title: Jobar Organizing Jewelry Valet coated wire (White) (14.5"H x 23.75"W x 2.375"D)
description: The Organizing Jewelry Valet is the ultimate hanging jewelry organizer, ready to store hundreds of jewelry pieces, keeping them tangle-free and ready for easy access! Made of coated wire, this over the door jewelry rack can be wall mounted or used over the door with the included hooks. Assembly level/degree of difficulty: Moderate.
